Lynels, however, can swing it effectively with a single hand.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 14 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lynel Spear}} Lynel Spears are [[Weapon]]s made and used by [[Lynel]]s. In [[Master Mode]], however, [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s make use of Lynel Spears, since regular Lynels wielding Lynel Spears are not present. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons created by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} While their crescent shape makes them unbalanced and difficult for [[Hylian]]s to use, Lynels are able to swing them efficiently. They are most commonly found in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[West Necluda]], though they can only be obtained by defeating Lynels. Being made of metal, Lynel Spears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]].
